extracted.intended_audience: NLP / machine learning researchers and practitioners building or evaluating natural language understanding models
extracted.subtask_description: Use the GLUE benchmark and its diagnostic suite to evaluate and analyze natural language understanding models' generality, cross-task transfer, and linguistic capabilities across a diverse set of existing NLU tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generality of NLU models
rubrics_metrics.description: NLU technology must be general: it must be able to process language in a way that is not exclusively tailored to any one specific task or dataset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate models on their ability to perform well across multiple, diverse tasks (rather than overfitting to a single dataset). Prefer models demonstrating transferable representations and robust behavior when applied beyond a single task/domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation across a diverse range of existing NLU tasks
rubrics_metrics.description: GLUE is a tool for evaluating and analyzing the performance of models across a diverse range of existing NLU tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a suite of heterogeneous tasks included in the benchmark to measure performance; aggregate results to characterize overall NLU ability. Ensure chosen tasks cover varied phenomena so evaluation reflects broad competence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model-agnostic benchmarking
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design evaluations and leaderboards that accept any model architecture or training procedure, enabling apples-to-apples comparison of different approaches without requiring model-specific adaptations to the benchmark.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incentivize sharing knowledge across tasks (multi-task/transfer)
rubrics_metrics.description: GLUE incentivizes sharing knowledge across tasks because certain tasks have very limited training data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess methods that leverage transfer learning or multi-task training to improve performance on low-data tasks. Explicitly evaluate whether cross-task training yields benefits compared to training each task in isolation, particularly for tasks with scarce labeled data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hand-crafted diagnostic test suite for detailed linguistic analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a hand-crafted diagnostic test suite that enables detailed linguistic analysis of NLU models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond aggregate scores, run targeted diagnostic tests probing specific linguistic phenomena (e.g., negation, coreference, world knowledge). Use these analyses to identify systematic strengths and weaknesses of models and to guide future model development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare multi-task/transfer baselines to separate per-task models (aggregate performance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Baseline multi-task and transfer learning methods should be evaluated and compared against the aggregate performance of training a separate model per task; initial baselines did not substantially outperform per-task training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report both per-task and aggregate metrics, and analyze whether multi-task/transfer approaches provide consistent gains. Use comparisons to highlight where current methods succeed or fail and to motivate improvements toward more general and robust NLU systems.
